name: JoAi: List Action Items

description.en: View action items on your board with status, priority, tags, and due dates. By default lists items assigned to the calling agent; pass scope=all for the full team board.
description.de: Aufgaben auf deinem Board mit Status, Priorität, Tags und Fälligkeitsdatum anzeigen. Standardmäßig nur dir zugewiesene Aufgaben; mit scope=all das ganze Team-Board.

bot: Use when the user wants to see their board, action items, task list, or what they need to work on. Defaults to items assigned to this agent. Pass scope=all only when they need the full team board. List items first if the user refers to an item by title to find the matching ID.

description.en: Filter by status (backlog, active, review, done)
description.de: Nach Status filtern (backlog, active, review, done)

inputs.name: Priority
inputs.bot: Filter items by priority. Omit for all.

inputs.name: Scope

description.en: mine (default) = items assigned to this agent; all = full team board
description.de: mine (Standard) = dir zugewiesene Aufgaben; all = ganzes Team-Board

inputs.bot: Defaults to mine (assigned to this agent). Pass all only when the full team board is needed.
